title: Submit an unsolicited proposal to NSW Government
summary: Submit an unsolicited proposal to the NSW Government if you have an innovative idea for building, financing, or providing goods or services.
intro:
If you have an idea to deliver an innovative project in NSW you can submit an unsolicited proposal to the NSW Government.

An unsolicited proposal is an approach to the NSW Government where the proposal has not been requested.

These proposals may be for building or financing infrastructure, providing goods or services, or undertaking a major commercial transaction.

faqs.a: An unsolicited proposal is an approach to the NSW Government where the proposal has not been requested.

faqs.q: Who can submit an unsolicited proposal?
faqs.a: Private individuals, companies, not-for-profit entities, and local councils can submit proposals. The non-government sector can also lodge proposals.

faqs.q: What types of projects can I propose?
faqs.a: Proposals may be for building or financing infrastructure, providing goods or services, or undertaking a major commercial transaction.
